### RMIT University is committed to growing and nurturing talent, while delivering a range of quality higher education programs in Vietnam. We encourage you to review our range of scholarships and apply for any that you are eligible for.

## All future student scholarships 2026

* Note that each candidate can apply for up to three (03) scholarship categories (excluding the Opportunity Scholarship). If the applicant is successful in more than one category, only one (01) scholarship will be awarded. Scholarships cannot be combined or held concurrently.

### Vice-Chancellor's Scholars

Vice-Chancellor’s Scholars are identified among those scholarship applicants who have achieved exceptional academic results and leadership while at high school.

Location: RMIT Saigon South, RMIT Hanoi

Learn more

### Academic Achievement Scholarship

The Academic Achievement scholarships are awarded to those scholarship applicants who have achieved exceptional academic results high school.

Location: RMIT Saigon South, RMIT Hanoi

Learn more

### Professor Nguyen Van Dao Scholarship

Professor Dao was an internationally acclaimed mathematician and one of Vietnam’s leading education administrators. He played a pivotal role in helping RMIT establish a campus in Vietnam. A scholarship is offered in his honour to the applicant with the best high school mathematics grade among all applicants.

Location: RMIT Saigon South, RMIT Hanoi

Learn more

### The Business School Scholarship

The Business School Scholarship is awarded to applicants who have achieved outstanding academic performance in high school and will be enrolling in an undergraduate program of The Business School.

Location: RMIT Saigon South, RMIT Hanoi

Learn more

### Tourism and Hospitality Management Scholarship

Offered to new students enrolling in the Bachelor of Tourism & Hospitality Management degree, the Tourism & Hospitality Management Scholarship is awarded to the applicants who have achieved outstanding academic performance in high school and have a desire to succeed in a tourism and hospitality world.

Location: RMIT Saigon South

Learn more

### Digital Marketing Scholarship

The Digital Marketing Scholarship is awarded to the applicants who have achieved outstanding academic performance in high school and demonstrate a passion for careers in a business environment characterised by accelerated change in technology and consumer habits.

Location: RMIT Saigon South, RMIT Hanoi

Learn more

### Bachelor of Business Scholarship

The Bachelor of Business Scholarship is awarded to the applicant who has achieved outstanding academic performance in high school and will be enrolling in the Bachelor of Business program.

Location: RMIT Saigon South, RMIT Hanoi

Learn more

### Luke McLachlan Scholarship

Luke McLachlan was a lecturer at RMIT Vietnam. He was a truly global citizen and an inspiration to those planning a future in global business. A scholarship is offered in his honour to the applicant who will be enrolling in the Bachelor of Business.

Location: RMIT Saigon South, RMIT Hanoi

Learn more

### Communication Scholarship

The scholarship is available exclusively to the students enrolling in the Bachelor of Professional Communication who have demonstrated creativity or passion within their existing practice through communication.

Location: RMIT Saigon South, RMIT Hanoi

Learn more

### Creativity Scholarship

The scholarships are exclusively available to prospective students with outstanding creativity and who want to transform their ideas into design solutions through the Bachelor of Design (Digital Media), Bachelor of Design Studies, Bachelor of Fashion (Enterprise),  Bachelor of Digital Film and Video, or Bachelor of Design (Games).

Location: RMIT Saigon South, RMIT Hanoi

Learn more

### International Studies Scholarship

The scholarships are exclusively available to prospective students with passion for international affairs and cultural diversity who want to transform their ideas into global impact and meaningful action through the Bachelor of International Studies.

Location: RMIT Saigon South

Learn more

### Women in STEM Scholarship

The scholarship is available for women who are pursuing undergraduate degrees in all programs of School of Science, Engineering and Technology.

Location: RMIT Saigon South, RMIT Hanoi

Learn more

### Opportunity Scholarships

The Opportunity Scholarships open to prospective students with disability and/or financial disadvantage who would not otherwise be able to access Higher Education.

Location: RMIT Saigon South, RMIT Hanoi

Learn more

### Computer Science Scholarships

The Computer Science Scholarships open to new students who have achieved outstanding academic performance in high school and will be enrolling in the Bachelor of Computer Science.

Location: RMIT Saigon South, RMIT Hanoi

Learn more
